others.name: Skyrise Innovation Limited
others.role: Shareholder owning more than 5% (owned by Ms. Nga Ting Tung)

what: It is a Hong Kong contractor that does building repair, renovation, maintenance and painting work, mostly on public projects.
proceeds: It expects about $21.6 million after costs. About 40% is for buying or investing in building work firms, 30% for painting equipment and machinery, 20% for hiring skilled staff, and the rest for running costs.
risks: New US rules may set tougher tests for foreign auditors who US regulators do not inspect, which could affect the company.
Cash and assets held in Hong Kong may not be free to move out of Hong Kong.
Court judgments that shareholders win against the company may not be enforceable.
The management team has no experience running a US public company or following the laws that apply to one.
The parent company depends on its Hong Kong subsidiary's earnings and payments to pay dividends.
